session.task: Plan and design a KFP Pipeline toggle view feature for CodeGraph (GitHub issue #1). Read the full codebase, understand the existing KFP static DAG extraction work (scanner.py, resolver.py, server.py), and design a dedicated pipeline visualization toggle that renders the full pipeline with proper input/output annotations so developers can validate their KFP code and function calling without a running cluster.

events.reason: Read all core files (models.py, scanner.py, resolver.py, server.py, store.py, html_export.py, json_export.py, codegraph_cli.py) and the full git diff to understand: (1) the existing CodeGraph architecture — AST scan -> resolve -> store -> serve/export, (2) the KFP additions already built — scanner detects @dsl.component/@dsl.pipeline decorators, collects KFPTask/KFPDataEdge, resolver creates data_dependency edges, server UI renders KFP nodes as rectangles with teal/cyan colors, legend items added. (3) What's missing: no dedicated pipeline-level view, no input/output parameter annotations on nodes, no ability to toggle between 'full codebase graph' and 'isolated KFP pipeline DAG'.

Designing the KFP Pipeline Toggle feature. After reading the full codebase and git diff, here is the architecture decision: The existing KFP work correctly extracts components, pipelines, and data_dependency edges. But everything gets mixed into the full codebase graph. What developers need is a dedicated 'Pipeline View' toggle that: (1) isolates just one pipeline's components + edges, (2) shows function signatures (Input/Output type annotations) on each node, (3) labels edges with the actual data flow (output_key -> input_param), (4) uses a clean top-to-bottom DAG layout instead of force-directed, so the pipeline reads like a flowchart. This requires changes to scanner (extract parameter types), server (new API endpoint), and server UI (new view toggle + rendering mode).
events.notes: Architectural design for KFP Pipeline toggle feature
